annotations.text:
/dashboard/matches/[matchId] — the delivered breakdown.

Direction A folded into the page that exists: the rail stays, the three destinations stay, and the lede is added at the top of the Statistics pane.

Left: a match with film. Right: the same page for a SwingVision import, where the proof is points rather than clips.

Sketch fidelity — grey bars stand in for prose, figures are sample values.

Kept for the record, not being built.

Current — the three-tab report as it ships today.
B, C, D — lead with the court, the film, the numbers.
Rail 3, 4, 5 — editorial, compact-with-a-shape, context.

The 300px match rail, two takes, both cleaned up.

1 keeps the line of score and leads with icons. 2 makes the result a table you can read set by set.

Each carries the edge case its first pass exposed — a long opponent name in 1, a five-setter with a tiebreak in 2 — so the block is specified, not just drawn.

Design system only: ink ramp, one blue, Roboto Mono on machine values (the duration) and never on stats.
